purpose: Teach: 買い手/忠告/転用/模範/必読/預かっ/コーディネート/休養

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新規事業の、買い手、絞り込んでいきましょう、ターゲット、明確に、することで、効率化、図れるよね、本当に、本当に、急務よ、絶対。
lines.en: We need to narrow down the buyers for this new venture and clarify our target — that's how we'll drive real efficiency. This is honestly urgent.
lines.style: Clipped, purposeful cadence. Energy that expects agreement. Quick breath-catch between clauses. Voice sits forward — this is business that matters. No hemming.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。先日の、お客様からの忠告、しっかり、社員に、伝えてあります、本当に、貴重な、ご意見、ありがたく、思っております、本当に、皆。
lines.en: Yes. I've made sure the whole team understands the feedback from that recent client. It was invaluable input, and we're grateful for it.
lines.style: Measured, respectful acknowledgment. Careful precision on the key words — showing the advice was taken seriously. Steady, no rush. The tone of someone following through on what matters.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 倉庫の一部、新しい用途に、転用しましょうね、本当に、効率化、急務だわ、本社全体、活性化、必要よね、社員、皆。
lines.en: Let's repurpose part of the warehouse for something new. We really do need to boost efficiency, and it's time we activated the whole headquarters. Everyone needs to be part of this.
lines.style: Clear directive, but warm underneath. Sits at eye level — not talking down. Builds momentum across the thought. A slight rise on 「必要よね」 as if inviting buy-in, not demanding it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の模範となる、先輩、新人、紹介する場、設けてまいります、本当に、世代間交流、活発化、社員、皆、ご好評です、最近、特に。
lines.en: Yes. We're setting up mentorship pairings — veterans paired with new hires — so experience gets passed on properly. The team's been really receptive to it lately.
lines.style: Steady, collaborative. Pride in the update without overselling it. Speaks clearly, lets each detail land. The tone of someone delivering good news about something the team cares about.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界の必読資料、私も、しっかり、読んでおきますね、本当に、リーダーとして、勉強、続けないと、ね、本当に、皆も、本気で、頑張って欲しい。
lines.en: I'll be reading through the industry essentials myself — I have to keep studying if I'm going to lead properly. And I want everyone else to bring that same commitment too.
lines.style: Personal conviction underneath the directive. Not preachy — more like thinking out loud while taking responsibility. Slight pause before 「本気で」, as if checking herself for the weight of what she's asking.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。先輩から、預かった大切な、書類、しっかり、引き継いでまいります、本当に、責任、感じております、絶対、間違わないように、徹底。
lines.en: Yes. I'm going to handle those important documents my senior trusted me with carefully, and make sure the handoff goes smoothly. I feel the weight of that responsibility — no room for mistakes.
lines.style: Measured solemnity. Weight on 「責任」 and 「間違わないように」. Not anxious — calm certainty. The careful, almost ceremonial precision of someone who takes a trust seriously.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: コーディネート、社内、若手と、ベテラン、合同チームで、本当に、進めましょうね、絶対、楽しい、新しい、視点、出てきそう、絶対。
lines.en: Let's move forward with mixed teams — pairing our younger staff with the veterans. I think we'll see some really fresh ideas come out of it.
lines.style: Genuine optimism with forward momentum. Open, inviting tone. Sits up slightly — this excites her. Lighter than the directives, but still purposeful. A smile underneath the words.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の休養期間、しっかり、設けるよう、人事と、相談、続けます、本当に、皆様の、健康、第一に、考えていきたいです、葵で、私たち。
lines.en: Yes. I'm going to keep working with HR to make sure our team gets proper rest. We want health and wellbeing to come first for everyone — that's how we take care of each other.
lines.style: Warm, grounded commitment. Slower pace than before — this is about care, not urgency. Soft landing on each phrase. The steady voice of someone who means what they say about people mattering more than the schedule.
